summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. The aggregate/window UDAF state lifecycle (export_meminfo +1 on init, borrow_structref net-zero per step/inverse/value, release_meminfo exactly once in xFinal and never in xValue) is balanced on every path, and the @cfunc exception boundary uses bare try/except (not try/finally) with sqlite3_result_error signalling -- the documented cure for numba's swallow + cross-call NRT leak. No refcount imbalance, double-free, use-after-free, or ABI mismatch found.
